{{Top|leg}}
'''Jawa Droid Traders''' or '''JDTs''' was the name used to describe the loose alliance of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] clans that bartered [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They ran [[Droidfest]].
